Standard: The maximum accelerations experienced by an occupant during escape do not exceed the maximum chest accelerations in TABLE XVII. TABLE XVII. Maximum chest accelerations. Direction Maximum Allowable Acceleration + gx 35 / 15 g* - gx 35 g ± gy 15 g + gz 25 g - gz 20 g * Note: +35gx chest prior to seat/occupant separation and +15 gx after. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Lab test: Chest accelerations are verified through full system-level dynamic ejection sled testing.
